success_definition.statement: Finish one readable four-panel manga page whose supernatural rule, emotional turn, and final choice are understandable without outside explanation.
success_definition.time_horizon: Review after the first fully lettered and continuity-reviewed page.
non_goals: Predicting sales from a one-page fixture
Expanding the pilot into a complete chapter during this milestone

intended_readers: Teen and older readers who enjoy concise supernatural mysteries
audience_and_positioning.reader_need: A complete, intriguing emotional beat with clear event order and enough unanswered tension to invite another page.
genre_demographic_format_promises: A supernatural rule is established through action rather than a lore dump.
The four-panel page reads right-to-left and resolves its immediate beat while opening a larger question.

market_hypotheses.statement: The bell-rule contradiction can create curiosity without action spectacle.
market_hypotheses.validation_method: Ask first-time test readers what question makes them want to continue.

differentiators: A small mechanical transit prop carries the supernatural rule and the protagonist's decision.
cultural_translation_notes: Explain the fictional station rule through visible cause and effect rather than assuming railway custom knowledge.

creative_execution.one_line_logline: At an empty station, a cautious teenager must answer a bell that rings only when an impossible traveler returns.

protagonist_drive.want: Mira wants to identify the source of the impossible bell.
protagonist_drive.need: Mira needs to act without pretending her fear is certainty.
protagonist_drive.stakes: Ignoring the warning may leave Ren and an arriving traveler exposed to an unknown threat.

creative_execution.emotional_core: Courage is a deliberate response to uncertainty, not the absence of fear.

early_hook.question_or_disruption: Why did the return bell ring when the platform and timetable say no one is coming?
early_hook.payoff_signal: The final panel turns the unexplained sound into Mira's concrete decision to face the tunnel.

escalation_and_reset: Move from the bell, to the empty platform, to the violated rule, to Mira's commitment.
Use the empty-platform hold as breathing room before the final choice.

opening_beats: Open on an impossible sensory event with immediate physical evidence.
movement_requirements: Every panel adds a clue, consequence, inference, or choice.
ending_beats: End on an earned decision that changes the direction of the next unit.

readability_checks: A first-time reader identifies the bell, the empty platform, and Mira's final action in order.
Dialogue adds the station rule or inference and does not repeat visible information.
SFX meaning remains understandable in the output language.
repeatable_identity: Quiet supernatural tension built from ordinary mechanisms, restrained dialogue, expressive acting, and decisive black-and-white contrast.

publishing_strategy.cadence: One completed pilot milestone; no serialization cadence is assumed.

buffer.rationale: A buffer becomes relevant only if the author approves a serialized continuation.

format_requirements: Black-and-white screen page at the dimensions in project.json

discoverability_deliverables.requirement: A one-paragraph pitch consistent with the approved creative brief.
Use only the structured character-reference image jobs after production gates pass.

engagement_principles: Ask for concrete comprehension feedback rather than engagement bait.
moderation_and_safety: Do not expose private manuscript or test-reader information.

rights_and_contract_checks.check: Confirm authorship, collaborator permissions, and ownership before public release.

roles.scope: Creative decisions, approvals, rights, and final visual judgment.
Text, structured plans, validation, handoff, lettering, composition, review, and export; never artwork generation or editing.
External image generation from approved structured jobs and attached references.

agreement_requirements: For any paid collaborator, document scope, milestones, deadlines, payment, credit, confidentiality, and IP ownership before work begins.
outsourcing_triggers: Add human editorial or lettering support if clarity failures persist after two scoped revisions.
collaboration_and_sustainability.capacity_limit: Keep the milestone to one four-panel page until its workflow is verified end to end.
collaboration_and_sustainability.rest_policy: No release target may require skipping planned rest or approving work without review.
collaboration_and_sustainability.backup_policy: Retain versioned project metadata and keep externally returned image versions without overwrite.
financial_constraints: No paid production or release commitment is assumed until the author defines budget and runway.
efficiency_practices: Reuse page, lettering, and handoff templates.
Reuse only approved external reference assets and preserve their hashes.
Batch deterministic validation without lowering the human visual-review threshold.
scope_reduction_order: Never remove required clarity, safety, rights, or review checks

feedback_checkpoints.reader_profile: A reader unfamiliar with the pilot premise
feedback_checkpoints.decision_scope: Revise panel allocation, event emphasis, or dialogue load without changing approved canon.

feedback_checkpoints.reader_profile: Teen-or-older test readers, including at least one reader using the output language as a second language
questions: Was any balloon or sound hard to understand?
Did your eye follow the intended reading order?
Which panel carried the strongest impact?
feedback_checkpoints.decision_scope: Revise lettering or propose a new panel correction version; never overwrite approved artwork.

primary_metrics.name: unaided event comprehension
primary_metrics.definition: Readers can recount the four dominant events and Mira's final decision without explanation.
primary_metrics.target: All planned events are identified by every pilot test reader.
primary_metrics.data_source: Recorded answers to the feedback checkpoint questions.
primary_metrics.interpretation_limit: A small convenience sample measures clarity only, not market demand.

primary_metrics.name: production gate completion
primary_metrics.definition: Required pilot approvals, image intake, human visual checks, composition, lettering, continuity review, and export are complete.
primary_metrics.target: All first-milestone gates pass with no unresolved error finding.
primary_metrics.data_source: Manga Studio validation and approval records.
primary_metrics.interpretation_limit: A complete workflow does not guarantee artistic recognition, audience growth, or revenue.

experiments.hypothesis: Removing one explanatory line will improve pace without reducing understanding.
experiments.success_signal: Readers infer the station rule and final choice equally well while reporting less repetition.
guardrails: Keep audience boundaries and output language unchanged

pivot_rules.trigger: Two independent test rounds identify the same event-order or rule-comprehension failure.
pivot_rules.minimum_evidence: At least two readers per round describe the same concrete failure.

risks.risk: The restrained opening may read as static rather than tense.
risks.mitigation: Test event comprehension and emotional anticipation at nemu and lettered-page checkpoints.

risks.risk: External image output may drift from locked references or safe zones.
risks.mitigation: Use hash-locked references, technical intake, human visual review, and versioned correction jobs.

assumptions: No publication platform or monetization model has been selected for the pilot.

research_sources.notes: Used as planning input; market claims remain hypotheses until independently validated.
